name: Gladly
description: Support and helpdesk: people-centered customer service platform unifying voice, email, chat, SMS and social into one conversation per customer.
access_notes: No self-serve signup or public free trial; access is via sales-led demo (gladly.ai only offers 'Get a demo'). Once a customer, API tokens are created self-serve in-app by users with the API User permission (email + token via HTTP Basic).
mcp_notes: No vendor MCP found on developer.gladly.com or gladly.ai (their blog discusses MCP conceptually only). No Composio toolkit (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/gladly.md returns 404). StackOne hosts a third-party Gladly MCP server with 65 actions.
uncertainty_notes: Absence of free trial is corroborated by Gladly's own site (demo-only CTAs) and third-party sources (costbench.com, docs.runalloy.com); Gladly does not publish pricing. Searched 'Gladly MCP', 'gladly.ai MCP server', and Composio toolkit pages for MCP claims; only partner/aggregator MCPs found.

evidence.note: REST API at https://{organization}.gladly.com; 'token-based Basic Authentication', curl -u user@org.com:$GLADLY_API_TOKEN; token created by users with API User permission.
Admins create API tokens and webhooks in-app; tokens are per-user and per-environment (Sandbox vs Production).
Official site offers only 'Request a Demo' form — no self-serve signup or trial.
StackOne hosted Gladly MCP server (65 actions) — a partner/platform MCP, not vendor-official.
Gladly developer surface: REST API, Chat SDK, App Platform, webhooks, Lookup API; enterprise CX brands as customers.
